##### Project general facts

Jawaher Residences is a refined addition to the Maryam Island beachfront community, ideally located near the waterfront promenade and sandy beach. The 9-storey building comprises 198 thoughtfully designed units, ranging from studios to spacious four-bedroom apartments. Its architecture reflects a modern interpretation of traditional regional design, featuring clean lines, a soft beige and brown palette, and a harmonious integration with the surrounding coastal environment. Private balconies and well-planned layouts ensure a comfortable and contemporary living experience with scenic views of the lagoon, boulevard, and landscaped surroundings.

The development offers a wide selection of family-friendly amenities designed to enhance comfort and leisure. Residents benefit from a dedicated swimming pool, children’s pool, and a safe kids’ play area, complemented by a landscaped podium with shaded seating zones for relaxation and social interaction. Positioned opposite Al Khan Lagoon, the project also provides easy access to Maryam Island Boulevard, the beach, and Corniche Road, along with nearby cafés, retail outlets, walking paths, and green open spaces, creating a vibrant yet peaceful coastal lifestyle.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials, including porcelain tile flooring in living areas, kitchens, bedrooms, and balconies, paired with gypsum ceilings in wet areas and cement plaster painted ceilings in main living spaces. The kitchens feature MDF cabinetry with laminate finishes, solid surface countertops, and porcelain backsplashes, while bathrooms are fitted with modern sanitary ware, glass shower partitions, and durable fixtures. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to design and personalize their homes according to their own preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Jawaher Residences make an ideal home for residents to enjoy the beachfront amenities in the Maryam Island community, with its central location between the waterfront promenade, Maryam Island beach, and Maryam Island Park. The 800 m of waterfront promenade with a variety of cafes and dining spaces, as well as a 4,000 sqm community park with facilities such as walking and jogging tracks, basketball court, playground for children, and ample greenery to explore and  
enjoy, promise an active and healthy lifestyle.

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.

Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings. Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
